What is TOTSE?

TOTSE commonly mispronounced as "toot-see," "toat-see," or "toats") was a San Francisco Bay Area website and former BBS dedicated to storing text files on a variety of subjects and viewpoints, many of which were unusual or controversial. The name is an acronym for Temple of the Screaming Electron.

http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TOTSE

Where can I see a glimpse of it?

http://totse.totseans.com/

What's the mission here?

TOTSE existed before Reddit and even before Channers, it was a hub of useless information and it had a kickass community of talented users. However it died long ago and various attempts have been made to make it work. Unfortunately thanks to Reddit and other big social media groups, it's hard to make it out in the niche area.

However, I have faith in this website and I think we can make something like TOTSE here, TOTSE stood for freedom of speech and expression, you were free to discuss anything and it featured diverse content about drugs, pyro, chemistry, science, tech and even survival.

I hope that if users new or old band together we can make something really amazing.

So, please help me out. Join the sub and we will make history!
